summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing of Rozio-Killer SaaS. Backend health + auth + core APIs + streaming chat + admin all working. Two backend endpoints (chat/escalate, booking/confirm) return 500 due to Mongo ObjectId serialization. Frontend landing/login/dashboard/admin all render with all data-testids intact. Split-screen sandbox widget streams multi-language (Spanish) replies from GPT 5.6 Terra correctly.
passed: GET /api/me without token -> 401; with token -> profile JSON
POST /api/chat/stream -> SSE stream, multi-language (Spanish reply verified curl + UI)
Landing page loads with hero, CTAs, nav-login and nav-signup buttons
Admin login redirects directly to /admin panel (Toggle + Manual Creator + Client Database with 2 clients + Files/Instruction/Forgot/Deactivate actions all rendered)
Client dashboard: 3 tabs (knowledge/branding/matrix) all present; industry-select, instruction-textarea, crawl-url-input, crawl-btn, pdf-upload-input, sandbox-widget all found
Branding tab: color-widget-bg, color-bubble, color-accent all present
Matrix tab: calendar-grid and spending-add-btn present
Sandbox widget launches, Spanish prompt returned in fluent Spanish (streaming)

failed.issue: POST /api/booking/confirm returns 500. Backend log: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable")]. The endpoint likely returns the raw Mongo doc containing _id (ObjectId) which FastAPI cannot JSON-serialize.
failed.evidence: curl -X POST /api/booking/confirm with valid body {tenant_id, slot, customer_email} -> 'Internal Server Error'. Trace in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log points at jsonable_encoder ObjectId error.

failed.issue: POST /api/chat/escalate returns 500 with the same ObjectId serialization error. Endpoint must strip _id (or return a pydantic response model / dict without _id).
failed.evidence: curl -X POST /api/chat/escalate {tenant_id, transcript:[...]} -> 'Internal Server Error'. Backend log shows the same jsonable_encoder ObjectId failure.

failed.issue: Documented demo credentials demo@client.com / Demo@12345 stopped working after the /api/auth/forgot smoke test rotated the password. Password rotation is expected per implementation, but the demo seed does not lock it or reset on next boot, so the credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md can become stale after any forgot-password call on demo@client.com.
failed.evidence: Login attempt for demo@client.com after /auth/forgot -> 401. Fresh admin-created user logs in successfully.

action_items: Fix /api/booking/confirm and /api/chat/escalate: strip _id from Mongo doc before returning (or return a plain dict / Pydantic model). Currently 500s.
Optional: re-seed demo@client.com password to Demo@12345 on each startup so docs stay valid across smoke tests.
Note: GET /api/admin/settings is not implemented (405) but PUT works; public read is via /api/settings/public which is fine.
mocked_apis_confirmed: /api/knowledge/crawl returns static 3 products + US/EU/APAC delivery (as declared MOCKED)
Registration email is queued via Resend, temp password returned inline (as declared MOCKED for demo)
